TITLE = 'Camp Grayling'
LAT = 44.66
LON = -84.71
REF = 'Lansing'

REF_LON = -84.56
import math
R = 6371.0

p2 = math.radians(REF_LAT)
dp = math.radians(REF_LAT - LAT)
dl = math.radians(REF_LON - LON)
a = math.sin(dp/2)**2 + math.cos(p1)*math.cos(p2)*math.sin(dl/2)**2
dist = 2*R*math.asin(math.sqrt(a))

x = math.cos(p1)*math.sin(p2)-math.sin(p1)*math.cos(p2)*math.cos(dl)
brg = (math.degrees(math.atan2(y, x)) + 360) % 360
print(TITLE + ' - distance and bearing demo')
print('From ' + TITLE + ' to ' + REF + ':')
print('Distance: %.2f km' % dist)
print('Bearing: %.1f degrees' % brg)
print('Coordinates used are approximate public coordinates, 2 decimals.')
